body: A8 to A14 on the probe, then the plain app (profile build, only the Gradle file_picker fix), 18:04 to 18:32.U+000AU+000AU+002D A8 PASS (mood set, change confirm dialog, persists). A9 PASS (month nav, past-day sheet, add and edit on Sept 23, markers). A10 PASS with D18 (the result preview is always the day's first text line, not the matching entry). A11 PARTIAL: D19 (blooms only for days with a mood, though the empty state promises a bloom per journaled day), D20 (no streak anywhere on the phone; StreakCard is only in the desktop sidebar). A12 in the probe: text size, week start and sound gating work; D21 (only one sound cue exists though the setting promises page turns and chimes). A13 PASS: export opens the share sheet (stopped there); D22, the export file name uses a UTC timestamp; Delete all empties everything. A14 PASS: reference perf numbers only.U+000AU+002D Plain app: D1 re-confirmed (back exits). A12 reminder FAIL, D23 (Blocks): the alarm fires at the set time, but AndroidManifest.xml lacks flutter_local_notifications' ScheduledNotificationReceiver and ScheduledNotificationBootReceiver, so no notification is ever posted (no channel is created, no record). The reminder is on by default at 20:30.U+000AU+002D The renderer logs Vulkan and then OpenGLES Impeller at startup, a possible factor in D14 (unverified).U+000AU+002D Still to do on the plain app: spell check, the real gallery picker (A3), video playback recheck (D14), A15 write, save and relaunch. Then the report.
